user.title: Teams Busy Light
user.description: Creates a webhook that receives the Teams status from the script on your Windows PC or Mac.

data_description.name: Enter a person or computer name; "Teams" is added automatically (for example, Anna becomes "Teams Anna"). Leave empty for just "Teams".

create_entry.default:
Done! Enter this webhook URL in the installer on your computer (Windows: TeamsBusyLight.exe, macOS: install.sh):

`{webhook_url}`

You can view it again in the integration options.

init.title: Teams Busy Light
init.description:
Webhook URL for the installer (Windows: TeamsBusyLight.exe, macOS: install.sh):

`{webhook_url}`

data_description.timeout: Set Teams to offline when the computer has not reported for this many seconds (e.g. because it is switched off). 0 disables it.

outdated_app.title: Teams Busy Light app on {computer} is outdated
outdated_app.description: The Teams Busy Light app on {computer} has version {app_version}, the integration has version {integration_version}. Update the app: choose "Install version …" in its menu, or run the installer of the latest release (Windows: TeamsBusyLight.exe, macOS: install.sh). This message disappears once the updated app reports.
